name: Synthesis of Co(ttpp) (CHCl3/hexane reprecipitation)
plain_text_description:
NMR
CDCl3: decomposed
DMSO-1: Co(ttpp); No TrBr, BHT, Et3N·HX
DMSO-2: Co(ttpp), Co(III)(ttpp), hexane; No TrBr. impurity or decomposition from the NMR tube? Inhomogeneity of the sample solids?

Heat a 50 mL two-neck RBF in an oven (120°C) for >1.5 h.
[12.01., RT 21.4 °C, RH 27 %]
Assemble and fix a reflux condenser, a T-shaped connector, and a bubbler (filled with paraffin oil) at a Schlenk line.
Remove the RBF and quickly assemble it with a stir bar, rubber septum, and reflux condenser while it is still hot.
Evacuate (0.089 mbar) and heat the bottom part of the reflux condenser and flask with a heat gun (250°C). 
Backfill with N₂.
Add TAPP and TrBr (plastic spatula) quickly
Cycle with N₂ slowly x3
Add Et3N
Add the THF syringe. [10:57] ( Dark Green )
Start stirring (350 rpm)
Cover the flask with Al foil.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl₃ 500 µL, sonicate → ¹H NMR M1 [11:08]
Stop stirring. Close the N₂ connection. Add CoCl₂ quickly.  Purge with N₂ for 10 s. Close. Resume stirring. [13:58 ]
Bubble with N₂, 30 min. [14: 30]
[14:37 ] Heat to reflux (85 °C, 1.25 atm) for ca. 15 min (Dark green brown colour) 
Heat for 2 h (16:37)
Cool down to RT.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl₃ 500 µL → syringe filter → sonicate → ¹H NMR M2-CDCl3 [16:30]
→ 0.1 mL + DMSO-d6 500 µL → syringe filter → sonicate → ¹H NMR M2-DMSO [18:39]
plain_text_observation:
[ 12.01, RT 22.1 °C and RH 30 %]
Add 12.5 mL of neutral alumina in a 15 mL membrane filter holder (frit) with a membrane filter.
Attach the funnel to a vacuum and a 250 mL RBF.
Wet the alumina with THF
Load the reaction mixture
Elute with THF and full power suction with occasional digging of the top layer. (It took a long time to elute. The alumina pad became blue-green at the top with some streaks but not fully down to the bottom. Other parts became dark red brown. Eluate became red at the end)
Eluent was kept in the fridge o/n.
[13.01]
→ 0.1 mL + DMSO-d6 500 µL → ¹H NMR M4 [16:59]
[14.01]
Rotovap
Dry under vacuum, 1 h

CHCl3 deacidification
250 mL RBF
Basic Al2O3 --> 50 mL
CHCl3 50 mL (mix in flask ---> then filter)
Fritted funnel (por.4), suction adapter, 250 mL RBF
Filtered

Reprecipitation
Purified CHCl3 25 mL, sonicate (dark red solution)
→ 0.1 mL + DMSO-d6 500 µL → ¹H NMR M5 [09:17]
n-hexane 140 mL, manually stir, sonicate
Fridge, 30 min
Glass Funnel, Filter paper (big, 15A), suction adapter, 250 mL RBF
Filter w/ suction
Transfer & rinse w/ 2 x (purified CHCl3 3 mL + 10 mL hex)
Rinse w/ hex x2 (2x 15 mL)
Dry under vacuum o/n
[15.01]
20 mL vial, PTFE sealing (tare w/ lid: 8.94046g)
→ 479 mg product
-> NMR  (CDCl3, DMSO)
